da-non-sequitur.evidence: [first hashed review 2026-11-21] Construction 2 (Peter-Weyl diagonal) is valid at the formal level: given the isotypic decomposition with eigenvalues lambda_j(q), the sum over j of pi_j / (s + lambda_j) inverts s + Delta_q whenever every s + lambda_j is invertible. Construction 1 does not cover the stated range. The integral from 0 to infinity of exp(-(s + lambda)t) dt converges only when Re(s + lambda) > 0, not for every s outside the spectrum, and it is archimedean, while the statement is categorical. The closing claim that both constructions give the same morphism is asserted without argument; it holds only where both are defined. The Lean is not a proof of either construction (trivial witness).
